old: Box selection only selected elements fully inside the selection box (Wrap mode).
new: When the preference "Select on" is set to "Overlap", box selection will also select elements that are only partially overlapped by the selection box.
evidence_quote: Implemented in #11053: box selection can now select elements it only partially overlaps. Switch it in the main menu under Preferences → "Select on" → "Overlap". The default stays "Wrap", which selects only elements fully inside the box.
